corrections.reason: The printed text in Col 2 L08 clearly shows 'ርጕልና' (senility/darkness/blindness, paired with ድንቁርና), where ጕ and ል were misread as ኵ and ሰ.
Visual inspection of Col 2 L10 shows 2nd-order 'ኩ' (not labialized ኵ) and 6th-order 'ስ' (with the top-left serif of sadis), forming the canonical Ge'ez 'ዘርኩስ'.
The printed glyph in Col 3 L18 is 6th-order 'ስ' ('ርኩስ', nominative/predicate after አልቦ), not 1st-order 'ሰ'.
